title: Event Calendar and Dispatch Limits for the Demand Response Programs
content:
## Dispatch parameters

Demand response events under the Demand Response Programs are called within each program's event season, on its event days and inside its event window, and never beyond its limits on events per season, event hours per season and length of a single event. Dates are written month-day.

| Program | Event season | Program months (capacity payments) | Event days | Event window |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Peak Time Rebate | 06-01 through 09-30 | Not applicable | Monday-Friday except company holidays | 14:00-20:00 |
| Smart Thermostat Rewards | 06-01 through 09-30 | Not applicable | Monday-Friday except company holidays | 14:00-20:00 |
| AC Cycling Program | 06-01 through 09-30 | Not applicable | Monday-Friday except company holidays | 14:00-20:00 |
| Home Battery Dispatch | 06-01 through 09-30 | Not applicable | Monday-Friday except company holidays | 16:00-21:00 |
| Commercial Capacity Bidding Program | 05-01 through 10-31 | May through October | Monday-Friday except company holidays | 11:00-19:00 |
| Base Interruptible Program | 01-01 through 12-31 | Every month | Any day | Any hour |

| Program | Most events per season | Most event hours per season | Longest single event | Test events per program year |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Peak Time Rebate | 15 | 60 hours | 4 hours | 0 |
| Smart Thermostat Rewards | 15 | 60 hours | 4 hours | 0 |
| AC Cycling Program | 15 | 60 hours | 4 hours | 0 |
| Home Battery Dispatch | 30 | 90 hours | 3 hours | 1 |
| Commercial Capacity Bidding Program | 24 | 96 hours | 4 hours | 0 |
| Base Interruptible Program | 10 | 80 hours | 6 hours | 1 |

The Base Interruptible Program may call events all year; its limit of 10 events applies per program year. Test events count toward performance but earn no event incentive.

## Operating notes

- **Summer residential programs.** Peak Time Rebate, Smart Thermostat Rewards and the AC Cycling Program share the 06-01 through 09-30 season, weekday event days other than company holidays, the 14:00-20:00 window, and limits of 15 events, 60 event hours and 4 hours per event.
- **Home Battery Dispatch** uses the same season and event days but a later window, 16:00-21:00, with up to 30 events, 90 event hours and 3 hours per event, and 1 test event per program year.
- **Commercial Capacity Bidding Program** events fall between 05-01 and 10-31 on weekdays other than company holidays, between 11:00 and 19:00, with up to 24 events, 96 event hours and 4 hours per event. Capacity payments are earned in the program months May through October.
- **Base Interruptible Program** events may be called on any day and at any hour of the year, with up to 10 events and 80 event hours per program year, 6 hours per event and 1 test event per program year. Capacity payments are earned every month.

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical events)

| Hypothetical event | Program | Within the calendar and limits? |
|---|---|---|
| Wednesday 09-30, 15:00-19:00 | AC Cycling Program | Yes — last day of the season, 4 hours inside the window |
| Wednesday 10-01, 15:00-17:00 | AC Cycling Program | No — after the season |
| Tuesday 07-15, 17:00-21:00 | Home Battery Dispatch | No — 4 hours exceeds the 3-hour limit |
| Tuesday 07-15, 18:00-21:00 | Home Battery Dispatch | Yes — 3 hours inside 16:00-21:00 |
| Sunday 01-12, 02:00-08:00 | Base Interruptible Program | Yes — any day, any hour, 6 hours |
| A 16th event in one season | Peak Time Rebate | No — the season limit is 15 |
